summary: Profile page refactoring test completed. All features from the refactored profile page (from 1913 lines to 10 smaller component files) are working correctly. Tested logged-out view (Account/PRO tabs, Login/Register forms), logged-in view (Streak/Games/Coins/Friends/PRO tabs), admin features (Admin Dashboard link, Pro Mode toggle), and URL parameters.
passed_tests: Logged-out view renders correctly with Account/PRO tabs
Login form visible with email/password inputs and data-testid attributes
Register form visible with username/email/password/confirm password fields
Login flow works - admin@hypd.games / admin123 successfully logs in
Logout functionality works - shows 'Logged out successfully' toast
Logged-in view shows user avatar (first letter), username 'admin', email 'admin@hypd.games'
Stats grid shows Streak (2), Saved (0), Scores (1), Friends (0)
Streak tab renders with hero card, current streak (2), best streak (2), streak points (70), multiplier (2x)
Streak tab shows milestones and progress to next milestone
Games tab renders with 'No saved games yet' message and HIGH SCORES section
Coins/Wallet tab renders with coin balance card (0 coins)
Wallet tab shows Buy/Spend/History sub-tabs
Wallet tab Buy section shows 'Coin purchases coming soon!' message and coin packages
Friends tab renders with search input and 'No friends yet' message
PRO tab renders with plan cards (Free, PRO $4.99/month, PRO+ $9.99/month)
PRO plan shows 'Coming Soon' button (Stripe purchases MOCKED)
Admin Dashboard link is visible for admin user with data-testid='admin-link'
Pro Mode (Testing) toggle is visible for admin user with data-testid='pro-toggle'
Pro Mode toggle is functional - changes state when clicked
URL parameter ?tab=wallet opens wallet tab by default
Bottom navigation present on both logged-in and logged-out views (Feed, Explore, Leaders, Profile)
Hidden Admin Access link visible with data-testid='hidden-admin-link'
critical_code_review_comments: Profile page refactoring was successful - code reduced from 1913 lines to ~420 lines in main page.tsx
All child components properly extract their respective functionality
data-testid attributes are correctly placed for automated testing
State management and data fetching remain in parent page.tsx as expected for this refactoring approach
